Code generally looks fine. I tried to test but ran into this [problem](https://github.com/ubiquity-whilefoo/command-ask/actions/runs/13771814067/job/38512706806): 
```
   ⛅️ wrangler 3.87.0 (update available 3.112.0)
  ----------------------------------------------
  Total Upload: 32983.19 KiB / gzip: 2247.95 KiB
  Your worker has access to the following bindings:
  - Worker Version Metadata:
    - Name: CLOUDFLARE_VERSION_METADATA
  ▲ [WARNING] Your Worker failed validation because it exceeded startup limits.
    To ensure fast responses, we place constraints on Worker startup -- like how much CPU it can use, or how long it can take.
    Your Worker failed validation, which means it hit one of these startup limits.
    Try reducing the amount of work done during startup (outside the event handler), either by removing code or relocating it inside the event handler.
  ✘ [ERROR] A request to the Cloudflare API (/accounts/***/workers/scripts/command-ask-gdrive/versions) failed.
    Error: Script startup exceeded memory limits.
     [code: 10021]
```
[Cloudflare docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/errors/#validation-errors-10021) state:

comments.content: https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-ask/issues/71

The trouble I see is that, OpenAi and OpenRouter and most of AI providers have adopted the same API. So even if the param is called `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` a partner can still use the OpenAi endpoint and their key.
Which would break things for them. A fast and simple solution is to add handling for the error and rebuild the message. 
Then it's truly solved, this issue also exists in `text-conversation-rewards` (or did the last time I brought it up) which again should probably be handled to cater to complete-customization which has always been the goal.
